what: theodb_columnar zone-map skip-pruning (predicate pushdown consumer). The columnar TAM already WRITES a per-(chunk_group,column) min/max zone-map but never read it; this slice builds the consumer: the M100 CustomScan admits a WHERE, extracts col<op>const predicates (btree strategy, same-domain — D5), a DataFusion Filter applies them (final authority — D3), and decode_columns skips chunk groups whose min/max prove no row can match. Measured on a clustered 1M-row table.
hardware: DigitalOcean c-8 (8 vCPU CPU-Optimized dedicated), PostgreSQL 17.10 + pgrx 0.19.0, shared_buffers=2GB

dataset.clustered_on: y (sorted at load → tight per-chunk-group ranges)

reproduce: benchmarks/columnar_zonemap_ab.py (SET theodb.enable_columnar_agg=on; SET theodb.columnar_zonemap_skip on/off; SELECT sum(x) FROM cz WHERE y BETWEEN 450000 AND 550000 — ~10%-selective)
goal: byte-identical filtered-aggregate result AND skip path decodes <= 25% of the chunk groups the skip-off baseline decodes

correctness_gate.note: skip-on sum == skip-off sum == 300002.0 (D3 gate). Proven across ranges: partial-overlap (5000-15000), fully-selective (25000-26000 → skips 2/3), full (1-30000), empty (999999-1000000). The skip is an admission filter; the DataFusion Filter is the final authority over surviving rows.
correctness_gate.customscan_engaged: EXPLAIN shows `Custom Scan (theodb_columnar_agg)` on the filtered aggregate (admit accepts the WHERE).

verdict: GOAL MET. The zone-map skip-pruning consumer is correct (byte-identical to full decode, incl. the partial-overlap chunk group where the DataFusion Filter drops non-matching survivors) AND effective: on a clustered 10%-selective range it skips 89/100 chunk groups (decodes 11% <= the 25% target) for a MEASURED 7.29x lower latency (19.3 ms vs 140.8 ms). This closes the columnar 'where pruning unproven' gap (M99/M100/M103): the min/max directory the TAM already writes is now consumed.
honesty_note: The skip ratio tracks selectivity x clustering — on an UNSORTED column a 10%-selective range prunes little (each 10k-row chunk group spans the full domain). The 7.29x is on a clustered column; the verdict claims exactly that, not an unconditional speedup (public-copy.md rule 5).
scope: col<op>const on native-min/max types (I2/I4/I8/F4/F8/Bool); the M100 CustomScan aggregate path. Deferred (separate scope): text/date zone-maps (MinMaxKind extension), the seqscan path, OR/complex predicates, out-of-RAM. Un-pushable WHERE → native plan (correct, unpruned).
